<?php
// php php.php <src-dir> <op> <doc> <iters>
[$_, $srcDir, $op, $doc, $iters] = $argv;
spl_autoload_register(function ($c) use ($srcDir) {
    $p = 'MarkupCarve\\Carve\\';
    if (strncmp($c, $p, strlen($p)) !== 0) return;
    $f = $srcDir . '/' . str_replace('\\', '/', substr($c, strlen($p))) . '.php';
    if (is_file($f)) require $f;
});
use MarkupCarve\Carve\CarveConverter;
use MarkupCarve\Carve\Lint\DocumentLinter;
$src = file_get_contents($doc);
$conv = new CarveConverter();
$lin = new DocumentLinter();
$fns = [
    'render' => fn() => $conv->convert($src),
    'ast' => fn() => $conv->parse($src),
    'fmt' => fn() => CarveConverter::toCarve($src),
    'lint' => fn() => $lin->lint($src),
];
$f = $fns[$op];
$iters = (int)$iters;
for ($i = 0; $i < min(10, $iters); $i++) $f();
$t = hrtime(true);
for ($i = 0; $i < $iters; $i++) $f();
$jit = (opcache_get_status(false)['jit']['on'] ?? false) ? 1 : 0;
echo json_encode(['ms' => (hrtime(true) - $t) / 1e6 / $iters, 'jit' => $jit]), "\n";
